retrieved_chunks.claim: Under the Secure Benefit, the base sum insured doubles to 2X from day 1 for hospitalization. Plus Benefit adds 50% per claim-free year up to 100%, and Restore Benefit provides 100% instant recharge.
retrieved_chunks.source: HDFC ERGO Optima Secure Policy Wording Section 3.1 (UIN: HDFHLIP21557V022021)

retrieved_chunks.claim: No room rent capping or proportionate deduction applies across any sum insured tier. Covered up to Single Private A/C Room without co-payment.
retrieved_chunks.source: HDFC ERGO Optima Secure Policy Wording Section 2.4 (UIN: HDFHLIP21557V022021)
